desc: Developed in partnership with Hilton Yam, the Master Class 10-8 Performance 1911 reflects decades of real-world duty experience. Built on a hand-selected forged carbon steel frame and slide, each pistol is precisely fit by hand and paired with a 5-inch forged stainless steel bull barrel finished in black DLC for added rigidity and consistent accuracy. Select 10-8 Performance components enhance durability and control, while the Agency Optic System, developed with Agency Arms, provides modern red-dot compatibility.
